::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Oct 20th [1868]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Miss Sarah Jardine-Willoughby
:::

My dear [Miss Sewell](people/person_1301.qmd)[^1]
I think you will like to see what the [Literary Churchman](organizations/other_76.qmd) says of our [performance](cmy_books/cmybook_71.qmd) but please return it

yours sincerely
C M Yonge

Do you know anyone who would like one of these photos  I am selling them towards the school at Eastleigh[^2]

---

[^1]: Black-edged paper. The words ‘of our heliotropes’ written on the reverse in CMY’s hand.
[^2]: The name has been erased in ink.
[^3]: The [Church of the Resurrection](organizations/other_188.qmd), Eastleigh, being consecrated, funds were now being raised for a Church of England school in connection with it.  The photographs were of CMY herself.
